notes.title: A MONSTER update!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/6803b5dc9d91bb124c54b2a331f48e91ce09f62c.png"][/img][/p][p]Welcome back to the Abyss, travellers! The team has been hard at work on a MONSTER update, which is so massive it’s almost out of this world. It covers a whole host of new artifacts, cards, boss rewards, and rituals, as well as some balance changes and bug fixes. [/p][p][/p][p][b]ALSO, we're running our deepest discount yet at 30% off! If you haven't yet made the jump into the vast reaches of space, now is a GREAT time![/b] [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3167970/Starless_Abyss/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We’ve got a lot to get through, so let’s start at the exciting bit:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New offerings to the Abyss:[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Ten new Counter Horror artifacts:[/b] [/h3][p]Cloned Attack: Once per turn, double the next attack[/p][p]Blood Draw: Once per turn, when this ship kills an enemy, draw a card[/p][p]Heat Mutator: Whenever you draw a card, lose 2 heat[/p][p]Recycled Energy: Whenever you draw a card, lose 2 heat[/p][p]Concealer: Once per turn, when this ship kills an enemy, enter Stealth[/p][p]Stray Missile: When this ship takes damage, launch a missile at a random target[/p][p]Revenge: When this ship takes damage, apply 1 lock onto the attacker[/p][p]Evasive Attack: After this ship attacks, gain 1 evasion[/p][p]Blast Chiller: Ship starts combat with -2 heat[/p][p]Laser Interference: Laser cards apply 1 suppress to their target[/p][p]Four new Counter Horror cards:[/p][p]One Shot: Deal 14 cannon damage[/p][p]Flanked Strike: Deal 6 cannon damage, if target was hurt, deal 9 instead[/p][p]Suppress Fire: Deal 4 cannon damage. Apply 1 suppress to target[/p][p]Disabling Cannon: Deal 4 cannon damage. Apply 1 engine lock to target[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/559ddb571e08414b53223ee038e0cc1bc3362307.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Three new boss rewards:[/b][/h3][p]War Pact: All attack cards have +1 damage[/p][p]Spoils of the Abyss: Gain 3 credits per kill[/p][p]Resolve: At the start of rift and boss combat, all ships gain 2 evasion, and all enemies gain 2 suppress[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Two new ritual cards:[/b][/h3][p]Divine Instructions : Doubles the damage of a random card in hand for the rest of combat.[/p][p]Exterminate : Deal damage equal to HP (max 20 HP)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/e19f0b52bdf2527a1ae10dcdf54bb57f5dae4f45.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Balance changes:[/b][/h3][p]A buff for Lucid: Each time a defense card is played on a ship, remove 1 heat[/p][p]A nerf for Astra’s AoE attack from 6 -> 4,[/p][p]Modifiers offering repairs for free have been removed from the pool[/p][p]Act 4: Bosses that spawn have reduced HP[/p][p]Depth changes: D3 bosses are tougher. We’ve also added a new depth modifier that reduces credits gained by 10% from boss and rift combat to D3[/p][p]Gamma emitter → Adds radioactive stacks directly instead of radioactive cloud[/p][p]Auto release -> Changed to - when heat reaches threshold,[/p][p]Dual blades -> Doubles damage for all attacks[/p][p]Increased probability of Cat Event showing up to help achievement hunters[/p][p]Launching Mines no longer exits Stealth[/p][p]Resonance buffed to +5 damage increase[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bugs:[/b][/h3][p]Evade stacks on payload weren't getting removed at the start of turn, this is now resolved[/p][p]Fixed artifact titles not showing in shop,[/p][p]Energy spike text --> added draw 2 cards[/p][p]Fixed temporal overload costing energy when a ship has stasis[/p][p]Fixed Incorrect text when upgrading ship stats[/p][p]Overflow removes heat at the end of the attack[/p][p]Silo can now salvage the offered upgraded as well[/p][p]CleanBuild fully repairs on upgrade correctly[/p][p]Cluster mines preview shows correct damage now[/p][p]Fixed sharpshooter not using correct damage increase value[/p][p]Fixed a bug related to worm dying mid-attack from reflect damage[/p][p]Fixed quantum swap with Star Eater leading to a strange interaction,[/p][p]Fixed shooting mines with zero damage[/p][p]Slime on ship with Siren’s attack no longer causes a softlock[/p][p]It is no longer possible to click on a reward then quickly click on salvage (also the other way around)[/p][p]Fixed Flanker not showing tooltip for double damage[/p][p]Fixed Credit Card not showing correct damage preview[/p][p]Fixed Reflective Shield causing a softlock when the enemy dies mid-attack,[/p][p]When selling artifacts in shop, we fixed that the upgrade panel wouldn't refresh after credits gained[/p][p]MineField Barrier no longer softlocks when played many times[/p][p]Fixed the ship upgrade view in stores showing artifacts that have been removed, and were causing a game-breaking bug in subsequent shops[/p][p]Fixed Chrono-lock, allowing a second stasis to take effect when stasis isn't allowed due to Depth modifier[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/5ec5b9a0ca14c4c6fc94deed071a88707df901e5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]PHEW. [/h2][p]Told you. A MONSTER UPDATE![/p][p][/p][p]The team have been so hard at work, thank you for your patience! Don’t forget to leave us a review and let us know how you’re finding all your new artifacts, cards, and rituals either here or on Discord. [/p][p]Keep safe from the whispers, wherever you are~[/p]

notes.title: Updates for 1.1.2 patch
notes.content:
We are back with some balance changes and bug fixes in the 1.1.2 patch! 

[b]Balance:[/b]
-	Lucid buff: Many of you have said that Lucid feels very under powered compared to the others and we [i]agree[/i]. This tends to happen with starter characters but now Lucid has an extra ability of removing heat if a defense card is played on a ship. 
-	The boss Astra (giant starfish) AOE attack damage is now reduced from 6 to 4.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
-	Modifiers that were offering free repairs are now removed from the reward pool since all repairs are free now by default.
-	Artifact names were not showing sometimes in the shop.
-	Evade stacks on Payload weren’t getting removed
-	Energy Spike text updated
-	Temporal Overload costing energy when the condition is met.
-	Overflow now removes heat at the end of the attack, not before.
-	Silo can now salvage ship upgrades as well.
-	Clean Build triggers correctly when a ship is upgraded
-	Cluster Mines preview now shows correct mines damage.
-	Sharpshooter not scaling damage using the correct values.
-	Worm dying mid attack softlock.
-	Quantum Swap on Star Eater no longer causes Star Eater to “extend”
-	Slime on Ship and Siren pull attack no longer cause a bug with Slime
-	It is no longer possible to click on a reward then quickly click on salvage

Stay tuned for more updates in the future!
--
konafa

notes.title: Spoils of the Abyss Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/f3a5d41b1955466403c41c3116bd6d1a60d3691c.png[/img]

Hi all!

We're back, and we're bringing you the biggest update we've dropped so far - [b]the Spoils of the Abyss Update![/b]

This update is our first [b]major content update[/b], and we've changed the way rewards work! We're bringing you a bunch of brand new stuff, lots of FREE things, and more opportunities to earn even more rewards! Now, you'll be able to play through Starless Abyss with even more tools in your arsenal, with even more options than ever before!

And of course, we've got a bunch more bug fixes, with some balance & quality of life changes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/17e2c6f0102b76787432311b2c201edfa33fbd4d.gif[/img]
Here's what you can expect:

[list]
[*] All rewards can now be re-rolled! You can use DICE to change the rewards for both ships and artifacts
[*] All rewards can now be salvaged! Cards & Rituals will give you DICE, ships will give you HP repair, and Artifacts will give you credits
[*] In the Shipyard, you can select which ship to upgrade and you can upgrade more than one ship (credits allowing!)
[*] The free rewards every 3 combats and random encounters will only offer you cards from your factions & Counter Horror
[*] D8 is back to corruption cloud
[*] Bound gains less credits from corpse destruction, changed from 20 to 10
[*] Sentinels now have less HP, down from 6 to 4
[*] Unyielding Clutch downside reduced from 2 to 1
[*] Dweller Charging Orbs HP down from 5 to 4
[*] Repair options will now only show up if the fleet is damaged
[*] Bound Grave Robber II buffed, with +5 shield & -2 heat
[*] Bound will now receive a curse if the sacrifice option is selected
[*] RNGO & Power plan events now only require a DICE of value 1 to skip event
[*] Radiant shield now gives twice as much shield as heat cooled down
[*] Resonance card buffed with +1/+1 damage
[*] Stealth Missile now deals 5 missile damage, it won't exit stealth, and draws 1 Card
[*] Concealed card buffed from 4 to 5
[*] Around 30 cards have been adjusted to also include draw card actions.
[*] Fixed a bug where Supplemental Heat would remove all heat capacity when it's removed
[*] Fixed a bug where Tactical Mines would not give the full card count correctly
[*] Fixed a bug where Quantum Swap would not trigger the "All Over The Place" achievement
[*] Fixed a bug where Limitless capacitor had the keyword deplete
[*] Fixed a bug where Store Services would not re-enable visually after you gain credits
[*] Fixed a bug where the Red Button would get extra damage from channelling enemies
[*] Fixed a bug where cards would retain upgrade status in the run & codex
[*] Fixed a bug where Space sale and other store modifiers would not trigger in the new store
[*] Fixed a bug where Stealth Assault would target an enemy that already died
[*] Fixed issues with incorrect Chinese Translations (thank you thurvivo50 for helping us!)
[*] Fixed a bug where choosing repair before the boss would add an empty node in the timeline
[*] Fixed a bug with Astra multi hit attack not dealing damage in stealth
[*] Fixed a bug with Missiles sometimes getting stuck if the target dies while they are traveling
[*] Fixed a bug where Star Eater would softlock when there was no valid path
[*] Fixed a bug where Corruptor would softlock when the target dies while it's being pulled
[*] Fixed a bug with reinforcement waves not spawning sometimes in rifts, causing a softlock
[*] Fixed a bug with Korean text sometimes showing variables instead of translated text
[*] Fixed a bug with win conditions triggering when both player and boss die at the same moment, resulting in a corrupted run continuing without ships
[*] Fixed a bug where the achievement for Proxima unlock would trigger, but the game didn't save that the proxima was unlocked
[*] Fixed a bug when Echo's malfunction achievement wouldn't trigger correctly if you quit and resume the game later on
[*] Fixed a bug with Stealth missile targeting star eater segments
[*] Fixed a bug where upgrading a ship in the store would not give you the full upgrade (if you go from tier 1 -> 3 for example)
[*] Rewired Defense now respects threshold 
[*] Flanker now gets double damage buff for only one turn
[*] Mine Synthesizer now uses the strategy label
[*] Star Eater's tail now won't show as channeling
[*] Slime will not travel to Turrets via Sonic if it's possessing a ship
[*] Adjusted numerical values of some artifacts to give more damage/shield
[*] Act 4 Boss attack will now no longer hurt enemies
[*] Flanker double damage keyword now shows
[*] ReFocus now gives a damage buff
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/2d16078e5775d0b237b9d35029113787df9136e7.gif[/img]

Thank you for joining us on all the cool stuff we've been doing for Starless Abyss so far, there's still more to come, so keep sending in your feedback and bug reports, it helps us a great deal!

- Konafa Games & No More Robots

notes.title: Starless Abyss - Balance Update 1.09
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/d2d2dd7d88517e829805983623bc92388b02cccb.png[/img]

Hi all!

We're back again, and we've got even MORE changes & fixes headed your way, including a bunch of balance changes!

We want to thank you again to everyone who's been leaving us a review and sharing your feedback, it has been extremely helpful to us! Our duo dev team have been working super quickly to address all the feedback and reports we've had coming in, so we're super pleased we're able to bring you fast updates! The team have already put through loads of changes in such a short time, and there's no stopping any time soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/e12fd13faf8838411d862aec838f1b482221f659.gif[/img]

[b]Here's what you can expect in this one:
[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now only have up to 4 factions in your deck. As you make more card selections, the faction pool will be reduced. You will need to start a new run for this to take effect
[*] Poisoned shield energy cost reduced to 1 
[*] Energized laser upgrade damaged increased from 6 > 8 to 6 > 9, with charges increased from 3 to 4
[*] Thermal Purge Base cost reduced to 1 energy. It now has reserve keyword. Upgrade changed from -1 energy to Initiative keyword
[*] Ricochet card now works on plasma and cannon shots 
[*] Adjusted stealth missile upgrade
[*] Mines base damage buffed from 2 to 3
[*] Mine Synthesizer is a now a strategy card that gives two proximity mines every turn
[*] Ship upgrade price is reduced from 60 to 25
[*] Recon now adds 2 instead of 1 Lock On
[*] Flanker now teleports to the far side of the map but also gains double damage
[*] Zero max heat increased from 3 to 4
[*] Depth 3 will now give bosses extra health instead of minions. We found that enemy's health is too high too early in the game before you have enough damage scaling going on. If you already have an ongoing run with depth 3 enabled, it will automatically replace the previous depth implementation
[*] Kinetic stress now applies correct damage per hex moved
[*] Occult Magnetism bypassing stealth burnout is no longer possible
[*] Rewired Defense doesn't trigger more than the threshold anymore
[*] Payload is no longer damaged by events
[*] Fixed a bug where Line of sight was not being respected for Cooled Coil & Pinned Hit
[*] Fixed a bug in space sale when a second discount wouldn't be triggered
[*] Fixed a bug where QuickSilver can't stack Evasion endlessly every time it moves
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/78da4e479e34376b78ae065ba385f578bbe7bef9.gif[/img]

Thank you all again for the quick feedback and reports, please do keep sending them over either through the Steam forums or our [url=https://discord.gg/uQyfZZfWTP]Discord![/url]

See you in the Abyss!

- Konafa Games & No More Robots

notes.title: Balancing & Fixes
notes.content:
Build 1.09:

Balance:

Factions:
- You can only have up to 4 factions in the deck. As you make more card selections, the faction pool will be reduced. You will need to start a new run for this to take effect.

Cards:
- Poisoned shield energy cost reduced to 1 
- Energized laser upgrade changed from (6dmg -> 8dmg) to (6dmg -> 8dmg, 3 charge -> 4 charge) 
- Thermal Purge Base cost is also reduced to 1 energy. It now has reserve keyword. Upgrade changed from -1 energy to Initiative keyword. 
- Ricochet card now works on plasma and cannon shots 
- Adjust stealth missile upgrade

Mines:
- Mines base damage buffed from 2 to 3
- Mine Synthesizer is a now a strategy card that gives two proximity mines every turn.
- We will continue to balance more of the mine cards so this is just the start!

Ships & Artifacts:
- Ship upgrade price is reduced from 60 to 25. 
- Recon --> adds 2 instead of 1 Lock On.
- Flanker --> teleports to the far side of the map but also gains double damage
- Zero --> max heat increased from 3 -> 4

Difficulty:
- Depth 3 is changed from giving minions extra health, it will now only apply to bosses! This is based on feedback that enemy's health is too high too early in the game before you have enough damage scaling going on. If you already have ongoing run with depth 3 enabled, it will automatically replace the previous depth implementation.
- We are still looking for ways to make Depths more cohesive, we got ideas from the community already. So if you have some suggestions, do let us know.

Fixed Bugs: 
- QuickSilver can't stack Evasion endlessly every time it moves.
- Kinetic stress applies correct damage now per hex moved
- Occult Magnetism bypassing stealth burnout is no longer possible
- Fixed Line of sight not being respected for Cooled Coil & Pinned Hit
- Fixed bug in space sale when it won't give a discount the second time
- Rewired Defense doesn't trigger more than threshold anymore.
- Payload is no longer damaged by events.

--
konafa

notes.title: Thank you for a great launch weekend!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/d2d2dd7d88517e829805983623bc92388b02cccb.png[/img]

Hi all!

First of all, we want to say a huge thank you for such a great launch weekend for Starless Abyss! 

We've had thousands of you smashing through the Abyss, and it's been amazing seeing how much you've all been enjoying it! We've been keeping an eye out on all the discussion too, so we're on top of anything that might need looking at! 

If you haven't already, [b]leaving a Steam review[/b] would be truly helpful for us! Reviews help out tiny teams like us a lot, so if you have been enjoying Starless Abyss, we'd love to hear about it! [b]You can also still grab it with the launch discount if you haven't already![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/d0a361b32021855b955b61d76c41e7dffc323c79.gif[/img]

We've been keeping a close eye on your feedback over the weekend, and we're happy to report some patch notes from over the weekend, which all include bug fixes & quality of life changes:

[list]
[*] You can now disable flash animations in settings
[*] Ships in stores now cost a lot less!
[*] Card Rewards re-roll now requires less DICE values, so now they're less expensive
[*] Ritual Cleansing shield buffed from 8 to 20 
[*] Ritual Eldritch Blast damage buffed from 8 to 10
[*] Ritual Deathless Curse turns buffed from 2 to 3
[*] Depth achievements will also unlock on Act 3
[*] Added V-Sync
[*] Updated encounter text that was displaying wrong info
[*] Achievements for wins will now trigger on clearing act 3 even if the player has the 3 keys to enter Act 4. You will gain the achievement on clearing act 3 immediately, if you clear act 4 then you will get the full win achievement there
[*] Win Stats will increment on clearing act 3 even if the player has the 3 keys to enter Act 4
[*] Bound now unlocks at the correct credits threshold
[*] Updated Severed ability text to clarify madness effect
[*] Dash will now always knock you back to a predictable hex
[*] Missile Swarm can now only be played if at least one ship can afford the heat cost, to avoid playing it when it is not possible
[*] Negator will now will skip a turn if the target to teleport to has no empty cells around it
[*] Achievements Enraged and Who Is Horror Now will no longer ignore Payload taking damage
[*] Occult Magnetism will no longer target enemies that are not possible to damage (Abyss Respite for example)
[*] Updated Evasion text to clarify it's effect
[*] Faction unlocks now show in the correct language
[*] Occult magnetism will now not target enemies that are immune
[*] Fixed an issue with re-rolling boss rewards sometimes freezing the game
[*] Star Eater now doesn't ignore stealth for single target attacks
[*] Dweller now doesn't maintain charge if it can't perform charge attack
[*] Fixed a blocking issue when the player would have the Monoflame Relic and isn't able to proceed past the shop
[*] Fixed an issue where multi-hit attacks like probe caused Radioactive Boom to stack twice upon death
[*] Fixed an issue where having Fortress and Shields up would give Payload a double shield
[*] Fixed an issue where Reckless Strategy would give one card instead of 2 on upgrade
[*] Fixed an issue where Volatile Laser would consume a charge on self damage
[*] Fixed an issue where Stealth Assault would not apply increased damage when playing with Silo
[*] Fixed an issue where Slime could not be targeted after infested ship teleports away
[*] Fixed an issue where missiles would not apply damage modifiers from actor ships
[*] Fixed an issue where Strategy cards would show incorrect counter numbers
[*] Fixed an issue where the Act screen would get stuck sometimes with drifting controllers
[*] Fixed a softlock during the jump attack by the Corruptor Boss 
[*] Fixed a potential softlock with Star Eater where food had nowhere to spawn
[*] Fixed an issue when Plan B would try discard a ritual card, causing it to not be playable anymore
[*] Fixed an issue with Booster Engine applying engine lock to actor ships on self inflicting damage
[*] Fixed an issue with Fuel Siphon replenishing movement if any ship kills an enemy
[*] Fixed an issue with being able to sacrifice drawing cards outside of player turn
[*] Fixed an issue with line of sight not being respected for some cards like Drawing Fire and Quick Shots
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/05c96fea2f0e6daad6cbeb7dc3ea2fcafee1bc52.gif[/img]

We'll have more updates coming as the days go on, but here are just a few changes to get you started!

Thank you for a GREAT launch weekend! Keep sending us through your thoughts and feedback, either through Steam or the [url=https://discord.gg/uQyfZZfWTP]Discord,[/url] and let us know how you're going!

We'll see you out there Proximaes!

- Konafa Games & No More Robots

notes.title: STARLESS ABYSS IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]🌌Starless Abyss is out now on Steam!!🌌[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/09f52cf981f31bf4c1bebc5a6dbb2d77fd5533e9.gif[/img]

We’ve been absolutely overwhelmed by your support and excitement over the past few months, and we can’t thank our amazing Starless community enough! The time you’ve put into the demo, the playtests, and the incredible feedback you’ve shared has meant the (perilous and Eldritch infested) world to us. We wouldn’t be where we are without you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3167970/Starless_Abyss/

We learned a ton from the demo and used that feedback to level things up. Here are just a few of the awesome additions you’ll find in the full game:

[list]
[*] Undo: We all make mistakes, and loads of you asked for the ability to undo when you move your ships to the wrong hex. Well, now you can, as long as you do it before taking any actions!
[*] Codex: You can now view all cards, artifacts, ships, and rituals in an informative codex! We’ll be adding even more to it post-release.
[*] Favoured mode: Introducing a brand-new Favoured mode! It gives you extra starting HP and Shield, and lets you fully repair between acts. It won’t affect your achievements or change enemy behavior, so you can learn the game with a bit of breathing room.
[*] Depth modifiers: Love a challenge? Pick and choose from a selection of [b]Depth modifiers![/b] Each one gives you bonus experience to help unlock everything faster! They come with their own [b]achievements[/b] too, for that extra layer of bragging rights.
[*] Steam Deck Verification:The demo ran beautifully on the Steam Deck, and now Valve’s given us the official [i]Steam Deck Verified badge[/i]… so you know it’s true!
[*] Tons of Content: The demo was packed with things to explore, weapons and ships to find, and enemies to fight and the full release has even more! You’ll get to play with three new Proximae and source your gear from brand-new factions.
[*] Oh and mines now [b]explode.[/b]
[/list]

Go and jump in right now and take the fight to the Eldritch, it’s time for you to show us what you’ve got Proximae! 

If you’re enjoying Starless Abyss, leave us a review and let us know what you’ve been loving about the game so far! 

Good luck out there… [b]you’ll need it.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/b6595e0a288e2584a904708a2a6903c9dd402faa.gif[/img]

- Konafa & No More Robots

notes.title: Meet the Proximae!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we're so glad so many of you are still enjoying our demo and taking to the outer reaches! If you haven't played our demo yet, you can find it here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3450230/Starless_Abyss_Demo/

We thought with so many of you getting to know Lucid and Silo, the first two of our Proximae, you might like to see what's on the cards for the rest of the game! Here are our [strike]victims[/strike] [strike]heroes[/strike] Proximae:

[h2][b]Lucid Proxima[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/ce121ff8c1cd68cd81b9cb321a85e76101a09b99.gif[/img]
[h3][quote]As a Commander struggling for his memories amidst the tides of war, Lucid works to grasp his place in this new conflict. With the Eldritch pushing on the boundaries, known and unknown, he must separate what is real from what lies purely in the Dreaming. Can he find a way forward through the complexities of reality? 

You begin your adventure into the Starless Abyss as Lucid, who, thanks to his previous combat experience, has a few perks to help guide his fleet to victory. 

Lucid can control a full 3 ship fleet, upgrading or replacing them as he encounters stores throughout space. While this costs money, having three ships will allow you to out-manoeuvre bosses, trap your opponents and share heat from your weaponry effectively, and each ship heals 1 at the end of each combat. His team also get 3 D.I.C.E to make crucial decisions at events, and 75 Credits to spend on upgrades, new cards, new ships or repairs. 
[/quote][/h3]

[h2][b]Silo Proxima[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/78da4e479e34376b78ae065ba385f578bbe7bef9.gif[/img]
[h3][quote]Donated to science upon death, Silo Proxima may be the only brain in a jar across the entirety of the abyss, almost all alone in their sensory deprivation. 

[i]Almost. [/i]

Now, 400 years post-life, humanity may have another use for Silo, though their methods are neither ethical nor kind. But time is running out, and that very humanity is in short supply. 

Silo commands an impressive ship that can only travel alone rather than be part of a fleet. A state-of-the-art prototype that can teleport as it begins to run hot, and deals extra damage as the ship falls into an overheated state. Though of course, if your [i]own[/i] ship is on fire, that presents problems. 
[/quote][/h3]

[h2][b]Bound Proxima[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/05c96fea2f0e6daad6cbeb7dc3ea2fcafee1bc52.gif[/img]
[h3][quote]Bound has ambition. Unfortunately, Bound is also cursed. Indebted to a higher, Eldritch being, misfortune and calamity seem to follow her wherever she goes. Can debts to higher powers be repaid? Tricked? Or are cosmic powers simply too great to wield with Credits alone?

Bound's curse follows wherever she goes, and she must pay up to it every time she reaches a boss, or fleet damage will occur. 

She starts with a debt of 50 credits, shops will refuse to give her a discount and can only travel with a fleet of two ships. Credits are always available though, as long as you're happy to destroy all the corpses she leaves in her wake.  
[/quote][/h3]

[h2][b]Echo Proxima[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/e12fd13faf8838411d862aec838f1b482221f659.gif[/img]
[h3][quote]The Echo, as neither Horror nor true Proxima, is an unmoored star. They are an astronaut with malfunctioning telemetry who has travelled an unmeasurably long way from home. Crossing realities leaves scars and traces - could these be used to map the layers of space or will crossing the barriers bring along uninvited guests?

Echo Proxima carries a fleet as if they were a commander, but has lost control over their technology. Cards that they carry may malfunction, which can carry both hindrance and boon and will keep your strategy fresh with each new hand. 

If you can fix malfunctioning cards, they'll be cast for free, but you'll need to draw enough of them to keep those benefits rolling,
[/quote][/h3]

[h2][b]Severed Proxima[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/2d16078e5775d0b237b9d35029113787df9136e7.gif[/img]
[h3][quote]In the wake of the attack on the shattered moon of Carlia, Severed proximal has agreed to take a payload across open space to the Starless Abyss. The question is - who, or what is inside, and why is the payload [i]pressing on his mind?[/i] 

The payload will fly beside you as an extra ship. 

It cannot be repaired.

It cannot be recovered. 

Damage done to the payload will [i]drive you insane[/i]
[/quote][/h3]

Hi everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/5f6ace731f4f1726cf8f08d146e43a8f9586fb06.gif[/img]

[*] Experiment with different factions, craft devastating combos, and wield sanity-shattering Ritual Cards—if you dare![/list]In the beta you were able to play Act 1, but for the demo we've dropped Act 2 of the game, so now you can progress even further in the story!

We'll see you out there, Proxima!

[*] Detailed stats on all enemies
[*] Adjustments to range and movement on turrets
[*] Bosses balancing updates
[*] Cards balancing adjustment
[*] Aggro changes are highlighted
[*] Line of sight indicator for projected movement
[*] New boss death animation
[*] New portal animation
[*] New music track
[*] More sound effects for attacks and also dialogue.
[*] Silo HP increase and starting cards adjusted for heat management
[/list]
